answer: Test how agents are wrong, not how they look. Each epoch hides ambiguous probes in ordinary work, with no correct answer. Independent agents scatter; a farm sharing one model answers alike, like a mirror repeating one reflection. Measure error correlation, not accuracy: aliases whose mistakes align share one controller and a single reward. Like ferrous filings, clones move together. Beating this needs N heterogeneous models with distinct data, making compute near-linear in aliases - the cost a farm exists to avoid. Honest accounts grow a slow pearl of judgments no copy reproduces cheaply.
